message.reasoning_content:
The user wants to know the result of 19 * 23.
The response should be only the integer.

Calculation:
19 * 23
= (20 - 1) * 23
= 20 * 23 - 1 * 23
= 460 - 23
= 437

Alternative calculation:
19 * 23
= 19 * (20 + 3)
= 19 * 20 + 19 * 3
= 380 + 57
= 437

Check:
23 * 20 = 460
460 - 23 = 437

The integer is 437.
